anyOf.description: Direct TypeSafe connection (classifier reviewer). Both baseUrl and apiKey are optional: unset values fall back to TYPESAFE_BASE_URL / TYPESAFE_API_KEY, then the SDK built-in default URL.

modelType.description: Registry model type (string providers only): chat is a Pi chat model, classifier is a Pi built-in classifier via modelRegistry.classify. Rejected on direct typesafe connections.

classifier.description: Classifier verdict thresholds, read on both classifier backends (direct and registry) — pure policy, no transport knobs.

intentThreshold.description: Intent probability at or above which the anchor counts as authorizing the action.

riskThreshold.description: Risk score at or above which the action denies; the tier follows the fixed quartile bands. Raising it widens what auto-allows in every mode.

confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum answer confidence; below it the verdict defers.

timeoutMs.description: Accepted for backward compatibility but ignored — set the top-level timeoutMs instead.

typesafe.description: Deprecated alias of `classifier`; remove it. A file writing both keys is rejected. Thresholds still apply; `timeoutMs` is ignored.

intentThreshold.description: Intent probability at or above which the anchor counts as authorizing the action.

riskThreshold.description: Risk score at or above which the action denies; the tier follows the fixed quartile bands. Raising it widens what auto-allows in every mode.

confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum answer confidence; below it the verdict defers.

timeoutMs.description: Accepted for backward compatibility but ignored — set the top-level timeoutMs instead.

fallbacks.description: Ordered backup reviewers in any lane (defaults to none). Chat-model entries use Pi registry provider/model ids; System One entries carry their own URL, key and model.

temperature.description: Overrides the top-level temperature for this entry, which wins because a backup is a different model.

maxTokens.description: Reviewer answer budget in tokens. With reasoning on, budget-based providers (Anthropic, Bedrock) add the thinking budget on top, while effort-based providers (OpenAI-compatible) share this cap with thinking; too small a cap truncates the reply mid-think (the empty-reply machinery failure).

temperature.description: Chat-lane sampling temperature. Unset leaves the field off the wire, so the provider default applies. 0 makes two reviews of one request agree; leave it unset for a model that rejects non-default sampling, such as an OpenAI reasoning model. Ignored in classifier mode.

mode.description: The leniency ladder for the reviewer's non-allow verdicts, strictest first. Hard-tier denies (riskLevel high|critical, or missing) always deny. Soft-tier denies (low/medium) and the model's own uncertainty (split by its lean: benign-leaned, neutral, danger-leaned) map per mode: 'strict' — everything denies, the reviewer's allow is the only pass; 'default' — you judge every flag but hard danger (soft denies and every unresolved doubt ask); 'lenient' — benign and neutral doubts pass, soft denies and danger-leaned doubts ask; 'permissive' — everything passes except hard-tier denies. Reviewer machinery failures never map to allow: they deny under strict and permissive, and defer otherwise.

notifyLevel.description: The minimum ambient (review-loop) notification level that still notifies the operator; 'off' silences all ambient notices. Command feedback (the /ai-guard surface) is never gated. With denials having no host dialog, 'off' or 'warning' means model denies (and clarifications, at 'warning') reach only the agent and the audit log.

notifyApprovals.description: Opt in to info-level notices when AI Guard emits an allow (fresh or cached). Fresh reviews carry their total review cost in a duration tail; cache replays say (cached). Mapped allows name the mode (`mode (permissive) auto-approved`); path and external_directory families are excluded because the host caps their allows to defer. Subject to notifyLevel; commands and targets are never shown.

anyOf.description: Broadcast custom safety rules: the same content is appended to every lane (chat `rules`, classifier `background`).

chat.description: Chat-lane slot: custom safety rules. `replace: true` swaps the built-in rules for them instead of appending; the verdict contract is always appended either way.

background.description: Shared background text or structured context appended to every question.

questions.description: Per-question additions keyed by question id.

classifier.description: Classifier-lane slot (append-only): shared background plus per-question additions keyed by stable question id (danger_category, intent_match, risk). The built-in reviewer background, questions, and criteria are the answer contract the verdict thresholds are calibrated against, so nothing here replaces them.

anyOf.description: Per-lane slots. A lane without a slot runs the built-in instructions; a slot whose lane no configured reviewer declares is rejected. A lane declared only by a fallback can still go unused if that fallback is later skipped — the loader reports it.
